original:
module invoice_report
  purpose: Print a plain-text statement for several invoices, reusing the invoice module.

import std.console
import invoice exposing Invoice, Line

public function statement_line(order: Invoice) returns Text
  purpose: One row of the statement: customer, number of lines and total, in fixed columns.
  example: statement_line(Invoice(customer: "ACME", lines: [], discount_percent: 0))
    is "ACME          0 lines      0.00"

  let customer be order.customer.pad_right(12)
  let line_count be order.lines.length().to_text().pad_left(3)
  let total be invoice.total(order).to_text().pad_left(10)
  return "{customer}{line_count} lines{total}"
end

public function grand_total(orders: List of Invoice) returns Decimal
  purpose: The sum of every invoice total.
  example: grand_total([]) is 0

  return for each order in orders sum invoice.total(order)
end

public function main() needs console
  purpose: Print a statement for two sample invoices and their grand total.

  let orders be [
    Invoice(
      customer: "ACME",
      lines: [Line(description: "pen", quantity: 10, unit_price: 1.00)],
      discount_percent: 10
    ),
    Invoice(
      customer: "Globex",
      lines: [
        Line(description: "notebook", quantity: 2, unit_price: 4.50),
        Line(description: "stapler", quantity: 1, unit_price: 12.00)
      ],
      discount_percent: 0
    )
  ]
  for each order in orders sorted by order.customer
    console.print(statement_line(order))
  end
  console.print("grand total: {grand_total(orders)}")
end
